title: Otter AI vs Fireflies Pricing: Plans Compared (2026)
summary: Otter AI vs Fireflies pricing shows Pro plans are $1.67 apart, but limits on transcription minutes and storage determine the difference.
body_markdown:
## All Fireflies plans and pricing limits


Fireflies has two paid tiers: Pro at[$10 to $18 per seat per month](https://guide.fireflies.ai/articles/9606045468-fireflies-billing-terms) and Business at[$19 to $29](https://guide.fireflies.ai/articles/9606045468-fireflies-billing-terms) .


To get the low end of each range you have to commit annually, which means month-to-month users forfeit access to the advertised minimums.


### Fireflies prices, checked from its own page


Pro costs $10 per seat per month on annual billing and $18 on monthly, an extra $96 per seat per year for staying month to month.


Business costs $19 on annual billing and $29 on monthly, an extra $120 per seat per year.


Those figures come from Fireflies' billing terms page. A limit that's changed since this was checked will cost you more than the price difference, so confirm the caps below on the pricing page the day you buy.


### Caps and features at Pro and Business


Both paid tiers offer unlimited transcription, so on Fireflies the first wall is rarely minutes. Pro stores **8,000 minutes of recordings per seat** , which is roughly 133 hours, while **Business removes the storage cap** , so indefinite retention requires a Business plan.


AI summaries are included on both tiers. Anything beyond the plan's allowance, such as extra AI tools, draws on credits bought as add-on packs, covered under hidden costs below.


Pro brings the core set: transcripts, summaries, search and the standard integrations. Business is where conversation analytics, team-level admin controls and fuller video features sit, so a team that needs those pays the Business rate no matter how few minutes it records.


### Fireflies Pro to Business price difference


Moving from Pro to Business adds $9 per seat on annual billing and $11 on monthly. For a ten-person team that's $90 or $110 more every month.


You're paying for the tier's added limits and controls, not for a different product, so first find out whether your team will reach the Pro ceiling.


Choosing monthly over annual moves the bill almost as much as the tier does. On Pro, **month-to-month costs 80% more than annual** , so the penalty for avoiding annual commitment's steep. On Business it costs about 53% more.


> Choosing monthly over annual moves the bill almost as much as the tier does.
